title: 1 Peso

obverse.description: Portrait of Bernardo O'Higgins facing right, engraver's signature if present at the left under the sash.
obverse.lettering:
REPUBLICA DE CHILE
So
LIBERTADOR
B. O'HIGGINS
FR.THENOT
obverse.lettering_translation:
Republic of Chile
So
Liberator
B. O'Higgins
FR.Thenot

reverse.description: The value and the date below within laurel wreath.

comments:
Different obverse and reverse dies were used.

Obverse
Die 1 - large portrait, epaulette with wide decorations, convex medals, script fine, signature FR. Thenot under the sash of the Legion of Merit of Chile.
Die 2 - large portrait, epaulette with wide decorations, medals almost incused, script bold, signature under the sash.
Die 3 - small portrait, narrow epaulette and the sash, medals stylized, no signature under the sash, wide script to LIBERTADOR B.O'HIGGINS, period between B and O in the center.
Die 4 - small portrait, very narrow epaulette and the sash, medals stylized, no signature under the sash, tall script to LIBERTADOR B.O'HIGGINS, period between B and O closer to B.
Die 5 - small portrait, narrow epaulette with wide decorations inside, narrow sash, medals stylized, no signature under the sash, fine script to LIBERTADOR B.O'HIGGINS.
Note. Additional features of haircut shown on images. Picture: © Images courtesy of Alexandr Prokofyev.


Reverse
Die A - wreath close to center, tip of '1' in denomination sharp, numerals in date wide.
Die B - wreath close to center, tip of '1' in denomination sharp, numerals in date narrow, the date condensed.
Die C - wreath closer to rim, tip of '1' in denomination blunt, PESO bold, numerals in date wide.
Picture: © Images courtesy of Alexandr Prokofyev.

Note. Each year the position of date, style of its digits differ from others. For example all '1' in die 2 sanserif, apart of in 1999, where there are serifs at the bottom.

Combinations
1+A: 1992, 2004-2006, 2008, 2009.
1+B: 1993-2003.
2+B: 2000-2003.
3+C: 2011.
4+C: 2012, 2013, 2015.
5+C: 2015.
